title: This Month in Accelerating Trump Fascism
author: Paul Street
content:
It’s hard to keep up with the fascism that is unfolding as the Trump MAGA
regime and party bid to consolidate a new form of governance atop the United
States. Below I attempt to catch readers up with some of the more relevant
developments in the Trump fascist project this month. .

**“We’re Not Going to Lose an Election for 100 Years”**

Let’s start with a chilling speech Trump gave two weeks ago at Mount Rushmore,
one night before the 250th anniversary of the United States’ Declaration of
Independence. The following passage deserves special mention:

_“There is now a resurgence of the communist menace in our land…You can be
loyal to Karl Marx, or you can be loyal to America. You can be a communist, or
you can be a patriot. You cannot be both…We’re [going to] send them into
exile. We will send them quickly away,.. We can only lose the midterms if we
…are foolish…But if we terminate the filibuster …and immediately vote for the
Save America Act, then we will not lose an election for 100 years. We do that,
we’re not going to lose an election for 100 years…The Communist Party is made
up of illegal immigrants, criminals, and everybody that doesn’t want to
work.”_

Trump here essentially called the openly capitalist and imperialist Democrats
“The Communist Party” and equated the prospects of the Democrats winning the
midterm elections this fall with the supposed menace of the US “becom[ing] a
communist country.” He wants one party – his MAGA fascist Amerikaner party –
to rule the country without serious contestation “for 100 years.”

The “SAVE America Act” is a draconian voter identification and suppression
bill premised on the fascist Big Lie of massive fraudulent noncitizen voting.

**An Evidence-Free Rant to the Nation on the “Deep State” Conspiracy to Rig
Elections Against MAGA**

Trump made another pitch for the SAVE Act in a wild address to the nation last
week. In a clear bid to sow doubt about the outcomes of the 2026 midterm
elections or perhaps to justify cancelling those elections, Trump went on
television to make thoroughly unconvincing and unsubstantiated claims about
noncitizen voting, Chinese interference in the 2020 election, and a “deep
state” conspiracy to hide evidence of that alleged meddling. None of the
heavily redacted and “declassified” information he cited provides any serious
basis for his charges. Trump then threatened three television networks (NBC,
ABC, and CNN) with the cancellation of their broadcast licenses because they
refused to grant him.

**Rubio’s Paranoid Global Conference About the Mythical Epidemic of Left-Wing
Terrorism**

Virulent and paranoid anti-communism, a hallmark component of fascist
ideology, was prominently featured in an unhinged lecture that Stephen “We Are
the Storm” Miller gave last week to representatives from 67 nations called to
Washington. The delegates from across the world were summoned by US Secretary
of State Marco Rubio to discuss the supposed global menace of “leftist
political terrorism.” In a series of deranged speeches, Miller, Rubio,
Commerce Secretary Scott Bennett and other top Trump administration officials
called the political left a “terrorist” threat and pledged to use all the
tools at their disposal to obliterate left-wing groups. Rubio brought up the
actions of the Weather Underground and the Red Army Faction more than half a
century ago to supposedly to preposterously invoke a new specter of bloody,
radical Left extremism. Miller claimed without evidence that the nation and
world are plagued by epidemic “left-wing violence” and labelled leftists and
left-wing organizations as “enemies of civilization” and a “cancer” that will
“destroy society” if not taken down. Miller even took aim at “anyone who
supports” left causes, accusing US institutions of being “soft” when it comes
to cracking down on “left-wing beliefs.” Adopting a “future crime”
perspective, Miller called on true Americans to work with the Trump regime to
target left people to “prevent a threat from occurring.”

The purpose of Rubio’s conference, deeply consistent with the legacies of
Mussolini, Hitler, Franco, and Joe McCarthy is to spark a global war of
repression on people with “left-wing beliefs.” As _Reich-Wing Watch_ noted:
“This playbook isn’t new. After the 1933 Reichstag fire, Hitler blamed
Communists and declared: ‘we must crush out this murderous pest with an iron
fist.’ Cancer. Pest. Terrorists. Root them out. We’ve read this script before,
and we know how it ends.”

The Trump regime’s conference speakers naturally made no mention of the well-
established fact that the lion’s share of political violence in the United
States is committed by the far-right.

**Trump Countermands the Suspension of Extrajudicial Traffic Stop Executions**

Then there was Trump’s rapid overturning last week of the Department of
Homeland Security’s decision to suspend ICE traffic stops after ICE killed two
legally resident Latino men – Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston on July 7 and
Joan Sebastián Durán Guerrero in Maine on July 13. Both men were murdered in
cold blood while driving their vehicles by ICE thugs. Both were unarmed.
Neither of them was the intended target of the operation that killed them. In
both cases the masked killers wore no body cameras to record the incidents and
ICE tried to justify the murders by claiming without evidence that the victims
had tried to run down federal agents. Civil rights groups have properly
described both shootings as “extrajudicial executions.”

The killings sparked angry protests that received national media attention,
leading the DHS to send out a memo directing agents to temporarily stop
pulling people over. Trump countermanded this order in less than 24 hours. In
a statement demanding that ICE keep making the lethal stops, Trump failed to
mention either of the deaths.

A Trump Truth Social post proclaimed, “we must be strong…we CANNOT give up one
of I.C.E.’s most important and effective Crime Fighting tools, THE TRAFFIC
STOP!” Trump insisted that efforts to hold ICE accountable are the nefarious
work of “Radical Left Dumocrats…I.C.E., go back and do your very important
job,” he posted. “Keep those Crime Stat Records coming!”

(Neither Lorenzo Salgado Araujo nor Joan Sebastián Durán Guerrero had any
criminal record. Both were hard-working fathers with legal US residence. Mr.
Araujo worked 32 years in construction, putting three sons through college.
Mr. Guerrero was handcuffed after being shot in the head in front of his
three-year-old daughter.)

**“More Bloodshed Unless They Shut Their Mouth”**

Right after Trump’s reinstatement of murderous traffic stops, Trump’s fascist
“Border Czar” Tom Homan blamed ICE’s and public extrajudicial executions of
Araujo and Guerrero on Democratic Party criticism of terrorist ICE raids. “It
all goes back to the Dems who want to continually attack ICE and tell people
to evade them and tell people don’t comply, tell people to resist, and tell
people ICE isn’t a real law enforcement agency…There’s _going to be more
bloodshed unless they shut their mouth_ and let ICE enforce the laws that they
enacted,” Homan told Fatherland (FOX) News. Department of Homeland Security
director Markwayne Mullen added that “were turning up the heat on the
streets,” boasting that “we’ve empowered our law enforcement to do their job.”

**Hiring Dangerous Abusers to do the Job of Terrorizing and Murdering Our
Immigrant Siblings**

It has been reported that Guerrero’s ICE murderer has a long history of mental
illness and domestic violence that his ex-wife tried to warn his former
employers (including the US Army) about. This is an indication of the kind of
people DHS is rushing into service in their effort to rapidly fill to do the
Trump-Miller regime’s “job” of sweeping millions of our immigrant brothers and
sisters into deadly concentration camps.

**Calling a Lone Wolf Terrorist an “Anti-Ice Rioter”**

Last Monday, Andrew Arabaka, a mentally ill US military veteran opposed to
ICE, threw an incendiary device at 26 Federal Plaza in Manhattan, home to a
leading ICE immigration court. Trump’s fascist FBI has subsequently described
Arabaka as an “anti-ICE rioter,” adding that “26 Federal Plaza has long been a
target of extremists, or terrorists.” The FBI’s conflation of Arabaka’s lone-
wolf terrorist act with the ongoing exercise of free speech and public
assembly rights against the mass deportation terror campaign is part of a
deepening Trump fascist crackdown on dissent and “the left.”

**A Threat to “Exile” Leftists**

Consistent with Rubio’s recent wild claim that the “civilized world” is under
attack by “left wing terrorism,” and with Trump’s July 3rd threat to send
communists into “exile,” Trump’s fascist Department of [in]Justice last week
undertook its first ever application to the never before-used **Alien
Terrorist Removal Court**. This obscure body permits the regime to rapidly and
secretly deport anyone it deems an “alien terrorist” threat. The criteria for
determining if someone is an "alien terrorist" is undefined, with the power to
designate people that way granted to Trump’s Secretary of State or Attorney
General.

The threat to “exile” dissidents should not be laughed off. The Trump47 regime
has already violated international law by deporting people to black box
torture camps in remote nations. And the tyrant-in-chief has previously
threatened to deport political rivals. Leading up to the 2025 New York City
mayoral election, Mein Trumpf threatened to “arrest Zohran Mamdani,” strip him
of his citizenship, and “to deport him…As President of the United States,”
Trump said, “I’m not going to let this Communist Lunatic destroy New York.”
Never mind that the subsequently elected Mamdani is a reformist social
democrat who ran on a platform of making New York more affordable for working-
and middle-class people.

**Hauling in Journalists.**

Two weeks ago**,** Trump ordered his Justice Department (currently headed by
his personal J6 attorney Todd “I’m His Lawyer” Blanche) to undertake the
nakedly repressive step of delivering subpoenas to the personal homes of _New
York Times_ journalists who reported on security problems with the new Air
Force One plane that Trump corruptly accepted from the nation of Qatar. The
Trump regime is trying to compel the reporters to divulge their sources before
a grand jury. The message to news personnel is clear: reporting findings the
Dear Leader doesn’t like can put you at risk of arrest and incarceration. "The
appearance of Federal law enforcement agents on the doorstep of news reporters
should shock the conscience of any American who believes in the Constitution
and the press freedom it protects," David McCraw, senior vice president and
deputy general counsel for the _Times_ , said in a statement.

**Blowing Off the War Powers Resolution**

We are now in the third week of the Trump fascist regime’s resumed war on
Iran. This abjectly criminal, brazenly imperialist war has been restarted by
the deranged US president in open defiance of a June 24 joint Congressional
Resolution directing Trump to remove US forces from hostilities with Iran. The
Senate’s vote for this measure marked _the first time_ that both chambers of
Congress have approved a concurrent resolution instructing a president to end
a military action since the War Powers Resolution of 1973 was enacted.

For what its’ worth the US Constitution reserves to Congress the power to
declare war. Trump responded to the resolution with fury, convening a closed-
door Capitol meeting in which he lambasted Republican senators for even
allowing the vote to take place.

**Threatening New Epic War Crimes and the International Criminal Court**

Trump this week has threatened collective punishment against the people of
Iran in response to the death of three US soldiers in his criminal war on that
nation. Earlier this week, he vowed to “punish Iran” for the deaths of three
US soldiers, saying Tehran would pay "many times over." Trump said the US
would strike bridges and power plants in Iran if the Iranian military did not
stop targeting ships in the Strait of Hormuz. “Any time the Islamic Republic
of Iran shoots at a ship” in the strait, Trump warned on social media, U.S.
forces will hit the sites, including in or near Tehran, a city of ten million
people. Deliberate strikes on civilian infrastructure and collective
punishment are major war crimes under international law.

That the Trump regime’s fascist war on the rule of law applies to
international we well as domestic law was seen yet again in bold fashion in a
blistering Rubio attack on the International Criminal Court (ICC) published in
the _Wall Street Journal_ last week. Rubio claimed that the ICC threatens
**“** US soldiers, police officers, Border Patrol agents and elected leaders”
under international laws that “we neither consent to nor control.” Calling the
ICC “an intolerable threat to US sovereignty,” The State Department mentioned
things will do to target the ICC: pressuring allies to resist ICC attempts to
prosecute Americans, travel bans on ICC officials, and increased sanctions on
the court. Rubio pledged the United States to an effort “to dismantle the ICC
brick by brick” – a truly chilling statement.

For the record, the ICC rules in accord with established international law on
four international crimes of which the Trump regime and previous US
administrations are richly guilty: genocide, aggression, crimes against
humanity and war crimes. International law is universally applicable to all
states; no country can choose to violate or ignore them. That is intolerable
to the American Empire and the America First Trump regime, reflecting the
takeover of the US government by a fascist section of the ruling class ready
to abandon all pretense of legality abroad as well as at home, has just
expressed its desire to crush the ICC out of existence.

**“The Iron Laws of the World”**

For some pre-July 2026 context for this fascist imperialism, we should recall
for er forget what Trump’s top political and policy advisor, the open fascist
Stephen “We are the Storm” Miller, said after Trump ordered the military
seizure of Venezuela’s sovereign head of state last January. “We live in a
world,” Miller intoned, “in which _you can talk all you want about
international niceties and everything else, but we live in a world, in the
real world … that is governed by strength, that is governed by force, that is
governed by power. These are the iron laws of the world that have existed
since the beginning of time_.”

**The War on Iran and the War on Elections**

We should bear in mind what the highly unpopular US president’s restart of his
illegal and unpopular war on Iran means for the mid-term elections that the
Democrats are naively hoping will contain Trump. Since everyone knows it will
send gas and other prices back up, as is happening, the resumed attacks offers
another among many signals that Trump aims to win the coming midterm elections
through massive federal interference, perhaps even cancellation, not by
anything remotely like normal campaign appeals to voters’ interests, At the
same time, a state of war is richly congruent with designs to declare a state
of emergency meant to cancel the midterms or refuse to honor their outcomes.

**“The Enemy Within”: Never Forget What Was Said in Quantico Last September**

Some more recent historical context seems appropriate here. We should also
never forget what Trump and his fascist Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said to
800 top military officers they brought from across the American Empire to
Quantico, Virginia, last September 30..  Hegseth instructed the commanders
that US forces must not let their mission of ruling the world through “maximum
lethality” be hampered by what Hegseth called “politically correct and
overbearing rules of engagement.”

Trump told the assembled flag officers in Quantico that the nation’s top
adversary is “the enemy within,” concentrated in “radical Left” and nonwhite
cities that Trump said should be used as “training grounds” for foreign wars.
“We’re under invasion from within,” Trump intoned, “no different than a
foreign enemy, but more difficult in many ways because they don’t wear
uniforms. At least when they’re wearing a uniform, you can take them out.” The
invaders are to be found in cities “run by radical left Democrats… San
Francisco, New York, Chicago, Los Angeles; we’re going to straighten them out
one by one.” This is a job for the US military, said the depraved commander-
in-chief: “A major part for some of the people in this room. **That’s a war,
too. A war from within**.”

Trump wants this war against “the enemy within” fought with Hegseth’s
testosterone-fueled rules of engagement, emphasizing a “warrior ethos” and
“maximum lethality over tepid legality” (Hegseth’s phrase). Trump told the
military leaders a timeworn imperialist story about a protester spitting in a
soldier’s face and the soldier remaining passive “though he wants to knock the
hell out of the person. If it’s OK with you, generals and admirals, I’ve taken
that off. I say, they spit, we hit. Is that OK? I think so.”

**Testosterone Pete**

In other news last week, Trump’s “Secretary of War,” the open Christian white
nationalist Pete Hegseth channeled the hyper-masculinism at the heart of
fascism by ordering that the military will now test its soldiers for
testosterone levels. Hegseth is concerned that the American “warrior class”
(his term) is not demonstrating enough manliness to performs its core tasks:
“kill people and break things for a living” and “unleash overwhelming and
punishing violence on the enemy” (Hegseth in Quantico last year).

**“I Saw Everything. You Did Not Need to Kill Him. You Have No Respect for
Human Life.”**

This is fascism. And so in its own way is the flat-out racist police state
public extrajudicial execution of young Black man in Madison, Wisconsin two
days ago. Watch a video of this terrible act here:

<https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1Bd9pxNVNo/>

After a white officer shoots the victim three times, a woman can be heard
screaming, "I SAW EVERYTHING! I SAW EVERYTHING! YOU DID NOT NEED TO KILL HIM!
YOU DID NOT NEED TO KILL HIM! YOU HAVE NO RESPECT FOR HUMAN LIFE.!”

The unfortunate tendency in these cases is for the issue to be kept local.
That is a mistake. The ongoing racist police murder of Black people, young
Black males especially, is a national epidemic that the genocidally white
supremacist Trump fascist regime will make no effort to halt. This and many
other racist police state hits that occur all too regularly across the United
States ought to lead to national protests that merge with the anti-ICE
protests and link further to a rising call for the removal of the Trump
fascist regime before it’s too late to block the consolidation of fascist rule
in the world’s most powerful and lethal nation – a deadly prospect for all
humanity.

The post [This Month in Accelerating Trump
Fascism](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/07/24/this-month-in-accelerating-

[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
